name: 保育所の職員算定と性暴力防止策を追加
summary: 一部を除く児童福祉施設に、子どもと接する職員の犯罪事実確認などを求めます。保育所では、条件を満たす理学療法士などを保育士数に1人まで含められるようにし、保育士による支援体制も定めます。
changes: 児童対象性暴力等の防止や発生時の子どもの保護に必要な措置を定める
犯罪事実確認などの必要な措置を義務付ける
子育ての知識・経験がある理学療法士などや所定の経験者を、保育士数に1人まで含められるようにする
専門職等や、専門職等と一緒に保育する看護師等への保育士の支援体制を求める

en.name: Adds staff-counting rules for nursery schools and measures to prevent sexual violence
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance Setting Standards for the Equipment and Operation of Child Welfare Facilities
en.summary: Requires child welfare facilities, with some exceptions, to take measures such as checking the criminal records of staff who come into contact with children. At nursery schools, it allows qualified physical therapists and others to be counted as up to one childcare worker, and sets out a support system involving childcare workers.
changes: Sets out measures to prevent sexual violence and other such acts against children, and to protect children if they occur
Requires necessary measures, including criminal-record checks
Allows physical therapists and others with knowledge and experience in childrearing, as well as people with specified experience, to be counted as up to one childcare worker
Requires childcare-worker support for specialist staff and for nurses and others who provide childcare alongside specialist staff
who: Operators of the covered child welfare facilities
Children who use the covered facilities
Operators and staff of nursery schools
